notes:
57 edits, all checked against work/book-2.json. Each find occurs exactly once in its field when the edits are applied in list order (simulated in the scratchpad). No find contains 域之兼, so the edits still match if they go into a round file (for example work/round4-edits.json, which ROUNDS already lists) that runs before global-replacements.json changes 族之兼 to 域之兼. Ids are stable ids; rendered numbers differ: 九·十九/二十一/二十二/二十三 = rendered 九·二十七/二十九/三十/三十一; 十六·十二 = 十六·八; 十六·十一 = 十六·七; 十二·二十三 = 十四·十一; 七·八 = 五·十五; 八·十四/十五 = 九·九/十; 十一·七 = 十一·八; 十四·八 = 十四·十二; 六·五 = 六·六; 四·二十三 = 四·二十一; 四·二十 = 四·十九; 一·五 = 一·十; 十四·五 = 十四·六; 十六·十五 = 十六·十; 十六·二十三 = 十六·十七; 十六·十九 = 十六·十五.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE AS A BODY EDIT
(a) The title of 凡·十三, 所出与据 → 所推与据. The edit format reaches only body, INTRO, DUIZHAO and HEAD. Simplest fix: add an entry to work/global-replacements.json, {"find":"所出与据","replace":"所推与据"}. The string occurs in the book only in that title (also in work/jing-all.md, a work file).
(b) Table rows in work/names-decisions.tsv, the source of NAMES-ZH.md and of appendix 一. The book renders these rows, and 十六·十二 quotes the 可介 gloss.
- 可介: 所名 「可＋介，一方可介一回应」 → 「可＋介，一方可介一所可为者」. In 注: 「新组合：可＋介，一方可介一回应。」 → 「新组合：可＋介，一方可介一所可为者（所可为者：articulates 之 R，各有所许之果；不是名表之应）。」, and 「经中写「一方可介一回应」。」 → 「经中写「一方可介一所可为者」。」
- 由: 所名 and 注 「一方于一回应有一助成之由（contributory reason，A、D 之所出）」 → 「一方于一所可为者有一助成之由（contributory reason，A、D 之结论）」. In 注: 「于此回应有由」 → 「于此所可为者有由」.
- 據: 「推导之所出之诸辞」 → 「推导所从出之诸辞」, which is the book's wording in 凡·九. Also 「诸律所出之前提」 → 「诸律所从出之前提」.
- 得 注: 「则所出者或阙或得」 → 「则所给之值或阙或得」.
- 狀值 注: 「（所出之值皆其状之 f 值）」, 「于域中所出者皆其状之状值」 and 「与所出之值方向相反」 → use 所给之值 in each.
- 規 注: 「C15 之回应 R」 → 「C15 之所可为者 R」.
- 出者 注: the line about C16 using 所出者 for derived claims is now settled (C16 writes 所推出之辞). Update or drop it.
- 同類積小 所名: 「FR 有限回应（finite responsiveness）」 → 「FR（finite responsiveness）」, to match 十六·十九.
- 取法 所名 「经他者实际回应之学」: I did not check whether this 回应 means 应. Please verify.
- Keep as they are: 應, 相應, 應域, 應式, 報 (its 「单环节之回应用「应」」 already gives 回应 as the gloss of 应), 共對, 一偏, 所履 (quotation), 下游, 代 and 在場 (lineage).

JUDGMENT CALLS
- 十六·十一: the 回应 there is what 皆愈 compares, and LiftBetter compares moves (a b : A). The 經 says 动, so I wrote 动 rather than 所可为者. That also avoids using 所可为者 one 條 before it is glossed in 十六·十二.
- I added a one-time gloss of 所可为者 in the 說 of 十六·十二: its place in Lean (R of Becoming.articulates; the sound policy in universal_reason is one), and that it is not 应.
- 回应 used with the sense of 应 in running text was changed to the name 应 (八·十四, 十一·七). The cases that were not 应 were reworded with the 經's own terms: 答 in 八·十五, 交回 in 十四·八, 动 in 九·十三, and 到达 for the G9 window in 七·八.
- 十二·二十三: 「对方之应」 was also changed, to 与. It is reciprocal giving, not ExchangeLaw.RespondsTo. 报 could not be used, because 报 is the table's name for LoopReturn.returnMap.
- 所给之值 brings in a second sense of 所给. The book uses 所给 about 100 times for 'given' (premise or data): 同为所给, 所给之序, and 所给之截面 in 九·十九 itself. In 九·十九's 經 I reworded the section clause so that the 經 has 所给 in only one sense. The 說 still has both senses. If this matters, the 篇九 wording should be revisited.

KEPT ON PURPOSE
- Every lineage use of 所出 / 出者 is kept: all of 篇十三 including NEW-12; C12 INTRO and DUIZHAO; C13 and C14 INTRO; 四·十一, 二·十六, 十一·十八 (parents in share_rises_through; descent_exhausted), 十五·五, 十三·二十二.
- The quotation 「夫迹，履之所出」 is kept verbatim (C01:DUIZHAO, 一·八).
- Places that match only as a substring are kept: 导出者 in 九·十三, 十二·十六, NEW-13, NEW-17, and 读出者 in the 經 of 一·十一. In 凡例, the verb in 无若而出之辞 is not 所出 and is also kept.
- 回应 is kept where it glosses 应: 八·十八, 九·十, 十一·二 (twice), 十一·七 (应域（回应闭包）). The new gloss in 十六·十二 names 应 but contains no 回应. Appendix 三, from work/appendices.md and not reachable by 條 id, keeps 开·应（仍能回应）… 交换回应一个积: this is the sense of 应.

FLAGGED, NOT CHANGED (outside the two strings)
出于 is the verb that defines lineage (x 出于 g), but it also appears in other senses: 'comes from', 'goes out of', 'exceeds'.
